```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(data.table)
```

# 1) Descriptive analysis

## 1.1) ave_temp: Monthly average temperature

```{r}

# a) Average by month
df_average = df %>% 
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(ave_temp_mean = mean(ave_temp, na.rm = TRUE))
  #the option ignores missing values

ggplot(data = df_average, aes(x = month, y = ave_temp_mean)) + 
  geom_point(size=2.5, color="2C7FB8") +
  geom_line(color = "2C7FB8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
    # match the showed x with the point.
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y="Average Temperature F°",
    title="Average Monthly Temperature F°, 1960-2004"
    ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    )
ggsave("1_temperature_month.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# b) Average by year
length(unique(df$year))

df_year <- df %>% 
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(ave_temp_mean = mean(ave_temp, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(data = df_year, aes(x = year, y = ave_temp_mean)) + 
  geom_point(size=2.5, color="2C7FB8") +
  geom_line(color = "2C7FB8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1960, 2004, by = 5)) +
  # position of y
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y="Average Temperature F°",
    title="Average Yearly Temperature F°, 1960-2004"
    ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    )
ggsave("1_temperature_year.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#c) Mapping
df_state = df %>% 
  group_by(stfips) %>%
  summarize(ave_temp_mean=mean(ave_temp))

library(usmap)
df_state$fips = df_state$stfips
pl_map = plot_usmap(data = df_state,
                    regions = 'state',
                    values = 'ave_temp_mean'
                    )
print(pl_map)


library(RColorBrewer)
pal = rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu"))
pl_map_pretty =
  pl_map +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal, na.value = "gray80",) +
  labs(fill = 'Avg. Temperature F°')
print(pl_map_pretty)
ggsave("1_temperature_states.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

# 5) Benefit-cost analysis

## 5.1) Predicted counterfactual mortality rate

```{r}

# SOUTH :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

# Mortality rate predicted
s_8104 = feols(ln_drate_6599 ~ days_above90 + days_8089 
                + days_below40 + devp25 + devp75
                | stfips^month + year^month,
                data = df %>% filter(south, year >= 1981),
                cluster = ~ stfips
                )
p_drate_s8104 = mean(exp(predict(s_8104))) # It is in log

# Formatting data
df_s8104 = df %>% 
  filter(south, year >= 1981, year <= 2004) %>%
  mutate(`stfips^month` = paste(stfips, month, sep = "_"),
         `year^month`   = paste(year, month, sep = "_"))

# Counterfactual prediction: Coefficients
scaled_s8104 = coef(s_8104)
scaled_s8104["days_above90"] = scaled_s8104["days_above90"] * 0.5

# Counterfactual prediction: Fixed effects
fe_s8104 = fixef(s_8104)
fe_vector_s = rep(0, nrow(df_s8104))
for (fe_name in names(fe_s8104)) {
  fe_vector_s = fe_vector_s + fe_s8104[[fe_name]][as.character(df_s8104[[fe_name]])]
}

# Counterfactual prediction: Results
comp_vars = c("days_above90", "days_8089", "days_below40", "devp25", "devp75")
X_obser = as.matrix(df_s8104[, comp_vars])
p_ln_drate_cf_s = X_obser %*% scaled_s8104[comp_vars] + fe_vector_s
p_drate_cf_s8104 = mean(exp(p_ln_drate_cf_s))

p_drate_s8104
p_drate_cf_s8104

# NON-SOUTH :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

# Mortality rate predicted
ns_8104 = feols(ln_drate_6599 ~ days_above90 + days_8089 
                + days_below40 + devp25 + devp75
                | stfips^month + year^month,
                data = df %>% filter(!south, year >= 1981),
                cluster = ~ stfips
                )
p_drate_ns8104 = mean(exp(predict(ns_8104))) # It is in log

# Formatting data
df_ns8104 = df %>% 
  filter(!south, year >= 1981, year <= 2004) %>%
  mutate(`stfips^month` = paste(stfips, month, sep = "_"),
         `year^month`   = paste(year, month, sep = "_"))

# Counterfactual prediction: Coefficients
scaled_ns8104 = coef(ns_8104)
scaled_ns8104["days_above90"] = scaled_ns8104["days_above90"] * 0.5

# Counterfactual prediction: Fixed effects
fe_ns8104 = fixef(ns_8104)
fe_vector_ns = rep(0, nrow(df_ns8104))
for (fe_name in names(fe_s8104)) {
  fe_vector_ns = fe_vector_ns + fe_ns8104[[fe_name]][as.character(df_ns8104[[fe_name]])]
}

# Counterfactual prediction: Results
comp_vars = c("days_above90", "days_8089", "days_below40", "devp25", "devp75")
X_obser = as.matrix(df_ns8104[, comp_vars])
p_ln_drate_cf_ns = X_obser %*% scaled_ns8104[comp_vars] + fe_vector_ns
p_drate_cf_ns8104 = mean(exp(p_ln_drate_cf_ns))

p_drate_ns8104
p_drate_cf_ns8104

```

## 5.2) Life expectancy

```{r}
#install.packages("pracma")
library(pracma)

beta <- 0.085        # Gompertz aging rate per year
max_age <- 120       # maximum age for integration

# function to compute the implied pooled 65+ rate for given alpha
pooled_rate_fn <- function(alpha) {
  # numerator: expected deaths
  deaths <- integrate(function(x) alpha * 
                        exp(beta * (x-65)) * 
                        surv_gompertz(x, alpha, beta),
                      lower = 65, 
                      upper = max_age)$value
  # denominator: person-years
  py <- integrate(function(x) surv_gompertz(x, alpha, beta), 
                  lower = 65, 
                  upper = max_age)$value
  deaths / py
}

# Gompertz survival function given alpha 
surv_gompertz <- function(x, alpha, beta) {
  exp(-(alpha / beta) * (exp(beta * (x - 65)) - 1))
}


get_life_exp_65 <- function (pooled_rate, # mortality rate
                             beta, 
                             max_age) {
  
  # convert pooled monthly rate to annual per-person rate 
  pooled_annual <- (12 * pooled_rate) / 100000 
  
  alpha_est <- uniroot(function(a) pooled_rate_fn(a) - pooled_annual,
                       lower = 0, upper = 1)$root
  
  e65 <- integral(function(x) surv_gompertz(x, alpha_est, beta), 65, max_age)
  
  return(e65)
  
}

le65_real_s = get_life_exp_65(p_drate_s8104, beta, max_age)
le65_cf_s = get_life_exp_65(p_drate_cf_s8104, beta, max_age)
le65_real_ns = get_life_exp_65(p_drate_ns8104, beta, max_age)
le65_cf_ns = get_life_exp_65(p_drate_cf_ns8104, beta, max_age)

```

## 5.3) Benefit-cost

```{r}

vlifeyear = 314000
pop_south = 22343459
pop_nsouth = 34939224

benefit_south = (le65_cf_s  - le65_real_s)  * vlifeyear * pop_south / 1e9
benefit_nsouth = (le65_cf_ns - le65_real_ns) * vlifeyear * pop_nsouth / 1e9

cost_south = 30
cost_nsouth = 70

ratio_south = benefit_south / cost_south
ratio_nsouth = benefit_nsouth / cost_nsouth

results = tibble(
  region = c("South", "Non-South"),
  ave_drate = c(p_drate_s8104, p_drate_ns8104),
  ave_drate_cf = c(p_drate_cf_s8104, p_drate_cf_ns8104),
  le65_real = c(le65_real_s, le65_real_ns),
  le65_cf = c(le65_cf_s, le65_cf_ns),
  benefit_billion = c(benefit_south, benefit_nsouth),
  cost_billion = c(cost_south, cost_nsouth),
  ratio = c(ratio_south, ratio_nsouth)
)
print(results)

#install.packages("gt")
#install.packages("webshot2")
library(gt)
results %>%
  gt() %>%
  gtsave("5_results.png")

```
